name: Margherita Pizza
tagline: Hand-stretched dough, San Marzano tomato, fresh mozzarella.

preparation.title: Shape the dough
preparation.description: Dough is hand-stretched and rolled to order, never pre-pressed.

preparation.title: Spread the sauce
preparation.description: San Marzano tomato sauce is spread edge to edge, left thin.

preparation.title: Layer the cheese
preparation.description: Fresh mozzarella is torn by hand and layered evenly.

preparation.title: Add basil & oil
preparation.description: Fresh basil and a drizzle of olive oil finish the top.

preparation.title: Fire it
preparation.description: Baked until the crust blisters and turns golden brown.

discover.chefNotes: We fire this at 480°C for 90 seconds, the same way it's been done in Naples since the 1800s. No shortcuts, no conveyor ovens.
facts: Named for Queen Margherita of Savoy in 1889.
Its colors echo the Italian flag: red tomato, white mozzarella, green basil.
Naples-style dough must rest for at least 8 hours before stretching.
discover.culturalBackground: The Margherita is the dish most associated with Neapolitan identity worldwide, and in 2017 Naples' art of pizza-making (Pizzaiuolo) was inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list.
